questions.stem: Use Gradient = (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁) for points (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂). Evaluate Gradient = (−3 - 7)/(6 - (−4)).
A speed is measured in m/s² in this typography check. Rewrite 25 cm² and 1200 kg/m³ using words for the powers.

The symbols v₁, v₂ and x₁₂ are labels. The relation v² = u² + 2as contains powers; s⁻¹ contains a negative power. Explain what the superscript in x³ means. Treat A < B & B > C as literal comparison text.

answers.final_answer: 25 square centimetres; 1200 kilograms per cubic metre
working: m/s² means metres per second squared; m/s³ means metres per second cubed.
cm² is square centimetres and m³ is cubic metres.

answers.final_answer: Subscripts label quantities; x³ means x multiplied by itself three times.
working: x₁, x₂, y₁, y₂, v₁, v₂ and x₁₂ use subscripts.
x², x³, v² and s⁻¹ use superscripts.
The literal comparison remains A < B & B > C.
